tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. The room around the notebook: screen background. Base default is pure white; Subnote uses warm desk paper.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. Body text and icons on background, card, popover and paper. Base default is near-black grey; Subnote uses warm ink.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. Raised surfaces: the Section list, form panels.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. Text on card. Alias of foreground.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. Dialogs, sheets and menus: the lightest sheet of paper.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. Text on popover. Alias of foreground.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. The one main action per screen (Confirm Setup). Ink, like the base's near-black, but warm.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. Label on a primary fill.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. Secondary buttons: pencil-shaded paper.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. Label on a secondary fill.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. Quiet fills: empty states, disabled-looking areas that stay readable.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. Supporting text and metadata on background, card and muted (4.7:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. Hover and selected fill for ghost buttons, menu items and list rows.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. Removing a Section, errors. As text, on background and card.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Label on a destructive fill. The base paints this with literal white; Subnote names it so the dark theme can flip it.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. Decorative hairlines between rows and around cards. Carries no meaning, so it may stay faint.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. Borders of text fields and outline buttons. Deliberately darker than the base's faint grey: a pencil line that keeps 3:1 on card and background.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: shadcn-svelte slot. Keyboard focus colour, used through the focus-ring shadow. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Dims the room behind a dialog. The base hard-codes black at 50%.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. A notebook page. Dimmed slightly at night; the book stays paper in both themes.

tokens.name: paper-edge
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. The stack of page edges beside the open pages.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. The dot grid printed on every page. Decorative only.

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Page numbers and pencil notes ("free") on paper. 5:1 or better on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Shadow where a page curves into the spine.

tokens.name: cover
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. The notebook's linen cover board, seen around the pages. Text on it is cover-foreground or cover-muted-foreground. The cover does not darken or lighten with the theme.

tokens.name: cover-foreground
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Titles and counts on cover: 8.2:1. The same in both themes, because the cover is the same in both. Do not use paper here: it dims at night.

tokens.name: cover-muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Secondary text on cover, such as the eyebrow and the label under a count: 6.6:1. The same in both themes.

tokens.name: board
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. The board the open book is bound in, when the book lies on cover linen (the phone's Notebook screen): a shade darker than cover so the book still reads as an object. On the desk the board is cover. The same in both themes. Paper on it: 11.7:1 light, 10.1:1 night.

tokens.name: elastic
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. The notebook's elastic band, drawn over cover on the closed notebook (first visit). Decorative; the same in both themes.

tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. The desk the open book lies on: the main pane on desktop, beside the linen side pane. A shade deeper than background in the light theme; the same as background at night.

tokens.name: desk-muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Captions and the pager on desk: 6.3:1 light, 7.5:1 night.

tokens.name: slip-foreground
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Text and icons on a slip (a Section's tint, or paper for a Free or Pending slip). Slips are paper, so this stays dark in both themes: 9.4:1 or better on every tint and on paper, night included.

tokens.name: slip-muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Metadata on a slip ("asked for 20 · rounded to 32"), the Free Pages label and the Pending badge: 5.3:1 or better on every tint and on paper, night included.

tokens.name: endpaper
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. The inside of the cover, before page 1 and after the last page.

tokens.name: section-sage
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Section colour 1 of 6, the ink: the edge band, the Section's name on its Title Page, its tab and its slip. Text at 4.5:1 or better on paper and on its tint in both themes: light 5.3:1 on paper, 4.6:1 on tint; night 5.4:1 on paper, 4.8:1 on tint. Never on card, popover or cover: there a Section's name sits on its slip.

tokens.name: section-sage-tint
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Section colour 1 of 6, its paper: the tab, the slip a Section's name sits on, and its squares in the PageGrid. It dims at night by the same step as paper. Text on it is section-sage, slip-foreground (11.1:1 light, 9.6:1 night) or slip-muted-foreground.

tokens.name: section-clay
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Section colour 2 of 6, the ink: the edge band, the Section's name on its Title Page, its tab and its slip. Text at 4.5:1 or better on paper and on its tint in both themes: light 5.5:1 on paper, 4.7:1 on tint; night 5.6:1 on paper, 4.8:1 on tint. Never on card, popover or cover: there a Section's name sits on its slip.

tokens.name: section-clay-tint
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Section colour 2 of 6, its paper: the tab, the slip a Section's name sits on, and its squares in the PageGrid. It dims at night by the same step as paper. Text on it is section-clay, slip-foreground (10.9:1 light, 9.5:1 night) or slip-muted-foreground.

tokens.name: section-ochre
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Section colour 3 of 6, the ink: the edge band, the Section's name on its Title Page, its tab and its slip. Text at 4.5:1 or better on paper and on its tint in both themes: light 5.6:1 on paper, 5.1:1 on tint; night 5.2:1 on paper, 4.8:1 on tint. Never on card, popover or cover: there a Section's name sits on its slip.

tokens.name: section-ochre-tint
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Section colour 3 of 6, its paper: the tab, the slip a Section's name sits on, and its squares in the PageGrid. It dims at night by the same step as paper. Text on it is section-ochre, slip-foreground (11.4:1 light, 9.9:1 night) or slip-muted-foreground.

tokens.name: section-slate
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Section colour 4 of 6, the ink: the edge band, the Section's name on its Title Page, its tab and its slip. Text at 4.5:1 or better on paper and on its tint in both themes: light 5.6:1 on paper, 4.9:1 on tint; night 5.5:1 on paper, 4.8:1 on tint. Never on card, popover or cover: there a Section's name sits on its slip.

tokens.name: section-slate-tint
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Section colour 4 of 6, its paper: the tab, the slip a Section's name sits on, and its squares in the PageGrid. It dims at night by the same step as paper. Text on it is section-slate, slip-foreground (10.9:1 light, 9.5:1 night) or slip-muted-foreground.

tokens.name: section-plum
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Section colour 5 of 6, the ink: the edge band, the Section's name on its Title Page, its tab and its slip. Text at 4.5:1 or better on paper and on its tint in both themes: light 6.1:1 on paper, 5.3:1 on tint; night 5.5:1 on paper, 4.8:1 on tint. Never on card, popover or cover: there a Section's name sits on its slip.

tokens.name: section-plum-tint
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Section colour 5 of 6, its paper: the tab, the slip a Section's name sits on, and its squares in the PageGrid. It dims at night by the same step as paper. Text on it is section-plum, slip-foreground (10.9:1 light, 9.4:1 night) or slip-muted-foreground.

tokens.name: section-teal
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Section colour 6 of 6, the ink: the edge band, the Section's name on its Title Page, its tab and its slip. Text at 4.5:1 or better on paper and on its tint in both themes: light 5.5:1 on paper, 4.8:1 on tint; night 5.5:1 on paper, 4.8:1 on tint. Never on card, popover or cover: there a Section's name sits on its slip.

tokens.name: section-teal-tint
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. Section colour 6 of 6, its paper: the tab, the slip a Section's name sits on, and its squares in the PageGrid. It dims at night by the same step as paper. Text on it is section-teal, slip-foreground (11.1:1 light, 9.6:1 night) or slip-muted-foreground.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Nunito, from Google Fonts. Everything that is the app, not the paper.

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: The title on a cover header below 768px, in cover-foreground.

styles.name: cover-title-wide
styles.usage: The title on a cover header at 768px and wider.

styles.name: cover-count
styles.usage: The large counts on a cover header (pages, Sections, Free Pages), with tabular figures.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog and sheet titles, headings inside a screen.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Page numbers in the page corner, in pencil, with tabular figures.

groups.name: Handwriting
groups.note: Gaegu, from Google Fonts. Only for what is written on paper, and for Section names wherever they appear.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: The Section name on its Title Page, in the Section's ink.

styles.name: section-name
styles.usage: A Section's name in lists and on Setup.

styles.name: pencil-note
styles.usage: Pencil notes on a page: the range under a title, "free" on a Free Page.

spacing.note: A 4px base, the same steps shadcn-svelte gets from Tailwind; Subnote names only the ones it uses.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; between a name and its metadata.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; between buttons in a footer.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field padding; between rows of a form.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and list-row padding; button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; between groups on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between major blocks of a screen.

tokens.name: page-margin
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. A page's inner margin, as a share of the page width, so a page lays out the same at any size.

radius.note: Smaller than the base (shadcn-svelte's --radius is 0.625rem): paper has crisp corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, the Section list.

tokens.name: radius-page
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. A page's outer corners; the spine side stays square.

tokens.name: radius-tab
tokens.usage: Subnote's own. The two outer corners of a Section tab.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: the Pending badge.

shadow.note: All Subnote's own: the base uses Tailwind's generic shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets and menus lifting off the desk.

tokens.name: shadow-book
tokens.usage: The open notebook resting on the desk.

tokens.name: shadow-book-on-cover
tokens.usage: The open book on cover linen (the phone's Notebook screen): deeper than shadow-book, because linen is darker than the desk. The same in both themes.

tokens.name: shadow-tab
tokens.usage: A Section tab's edge against the next page.

tokens.name: shadow-slip
tokens.usage: A Section slip (a SectionRow) lying on cover linen.

tokens.name: shadow-slip-raised
tokens.usage: The selected slip, pulled out 8px like the current Section's tab in the book.

tokens.name: shadow-pane
tokens.usage: The linen side pane's edge where it meets the desk on desktop.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in the background colour, then 2px of solid ring.
